card.name: Bible chapter and verse numbers
card.fires_on: The space, colon, dash or digit right after a book name like Acts or 1 Peter, just before or inside a chapter:verse number in a scripture citation.

modes.label: Scripture citation spacing
modes.description: The space or punctuation between a Bible book name and its chapter and verse numbers.

modes.label: Inside verse lists
modes.description: A colon, dash or digit within a run of chapter and verse references.

card.plain: It fires inside Bible references, on the spaces and punctuation around chapter and verse numbers.
